verdict.summary: Round 3 resolves the prior major finding. The source-install exemption is now keyed by workflow and job, its exact cardinality is enforced, and mutation coverage demonstrates that both a second release.yml job and a duplicate install inside gui-bundle are rejected. The repo-wide posture test passes, the converted workflow sites use the same SHA-pinned action and exact wasm-pack version, and the sole remaining source install is the documented multi-platform release job exemption.
